questions: Why do my new Windows cloud instances have high CPU right after boot?
How do I pre-generate .NET native images in a golden image?
Which module runs ngen on Windows from Ansible?
When can I safely run ngen during golden image creation?

answer_card.title: Avoiding high CPU on boot for Windows images
answer_card.answer_md:
If you build golden images, process the ngen queue during image creation to avoid a disruptive high-CPU task near startup. This only helps if the CPU types won't change between the image build and runtime (other factors can also invalidate native images; see MSDN).

Put this near the end of your image playbook:

```yaml
- name: generate native .NET images for CPU
  win_dotnet_ngen:
```
